groups.root_cause: The digest builds its needs-input and needs-review actions from stale historical records instead of the current unanswered-question and review state.
The digest keeps listing blocked lands without checking whether the PR has since merged.
MCP status gives an old failed review round priority over a later approval.
MCP status ignores the run's saved merged flag, so it only detects a merge from PR observations or landed queue entries.
MCP status checks old landing blockers before closed-PR observations, so a closed PR still gets fix-and-requeue advice.
The land list endpoint now rejects an empty run query parameter instead of treating it as no filter.
MCP verdict handling hardcodes the reviewer as "human" instead of attributing the verdict to the MCP agent.
The Codex skill's digest command passes the consumer name 'claude' instead of a Codex-specific consumer.
